objective: validator_score (deterministic in-loop check, e.g. replicate concordance or artifact-contract F1)

directives.EXPLOIT: Tune parameters of the current best stage/method.
directives.BOREDOM_SNAP: Switch method within an under-visited stage (see `suggest`); cite a source; check shared memory for prior failures.
directives.PARADIGM_BREAKOUT: Re-open an upstream stage (QC / normalization / batch model) instead of tuning downstream.
directives.CONVERGED: Frontier has stalled and every mechanism has been tried: re-run the current best (confirmation) instead of proposing new ideas.
